'''The Diamond Cavern''' is located within the [[Highlands]]  hidden away near the top of the mountain. A boulder needs to be removed to gain access to the cavern. 
==Forage==
The [[Diamond Flower]] is exclusive to this area and can be for gifting as it's widely liked or for profit.
